# Hindustan Projects (HiPRO)
> Engineering, Turnkey Construction, and Infrastructure firm based in Bhilwara, Rajasthan, India. Founded in 2019.

Hindustan Projects (HiPRO) is an engineering, civil construction, and infrastructure firm headquartered in Bhilwara, Rajasthan. Established in 2019 under the leadership of Founder & Director Yogesh Kharol, the firm delivers architectural planning, disciplined turnkey civil execution, precision surveying, interior design, industrial water treatment plant construction, and project management consultancy.

## Core Services
- [Professional Construction Services](https://www.hindustanprojects.in/services/professional-construction-services): Turnkey residential, commercial, and industrial civil construction with disciplined quality control and milestone execution in Bhilwara and across Rajasthan.
- [Architecture & Planning](https://www.hindustanprojects.in/services/architecture-planning): Master planning, 2D/3D architectural drafting, elevation design, structural drawings, and municipal sanction coordination.
- [Surveying & Site Measurements](https://www.hindustanprojects.in/services/surveying-site-measurements): Topographical surveys, boundary demarcation, contour mapping, and digital site measurements using Total Station and modern surveying instruments.
- [Interior & Exterior Design](https://www.hindustanprojects.in/services/interior-exterior-design): Spatial planning, bespoke residential and commercial interior fit-outs, material curation, and facade design.
- [Water Treatment Plant Construction](https://www.hindustanprojects.in/services/water-treatment-plant-construction): Civil construction and engineering for industrial Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), and water treatment infrastructure.
- [Project Management & Consultancy](https://www.hindustanprojects.in/services/project-management-consultancy): Site supervision, project scheduling, quality auditing, contractor coordination, and construction consultancy.

## Key Portals & Tools
- [House Construction Cost Estimator](https://www.hindustanprojects.in/cost-estimator): Free interactive construction cost calculator providing package-based BOQ estimates for residential construction in Rajasthan.
- [Project Portfolio](https://www.hindustanprojects.in/projects): Verified turnkey residential, commercial, institutional, and industrial engineering projects.
- [Engineering Insights & Knowledge Base](https://www.hindustanprojects.in/blogs): Practical engineering and construction guides covering construction costs, architectural planning, and bylaws in Rajasthan.
